What these levels mean

How this work is cited

Passages inside Mozi are identified by chapter (篇) by name, with the three-part division where it applies. 兼愛 is the chapter the corpus cites under three different English titles. The chapter survives in three parallel versions (上/中/下), which is why the part number is part of the locator and not a refinement of it.
